migration_flags.description: lot_producing_id (Many2one) renamed and changed to lot_producing_ids (Many2many) — schema change requires column migration and code update
date_planned_start renamed to date_start — all references in custom code, views, and reports must be updated
date_planned_finished renamed to date_finished — now computed+stored rather than plain writable; custom direct writes to this field may be ignored
analytic_account_id field removed entirely from mrp.production in v19 Community; no replacement analytic field exists in this model
availability field removed; replaced by reservation_state (confirmed/assigned/waiting) and components_availability_state (available/expected/late/unavailable)
Backorder creation no longer uses _check_backorder or _generate_backorder_productions; replaced by _get_quantity_produced_issues + _split_productions
_action_generate_immediate_transfers does not exist in v19 mrp_production; production confirmation is handled by action_confirm calling moves._action_confirm
New production_group_id field (Many2one to mrp.production.group) tracks backorder families; each MO now belongs to a group created at MO creation time

key_findings.state_machine: Six-state computed field: draft → confirmed (action_confirm) → progress (action_start or picking) → to_close (qty_producing meets product_qty) → done (button_mark_done); cancel available from any non-done state
key_findings.lot_producing_change: Critical: lot_producing_id Many2one changed to lot_producing_ids Many2many; single-lot constraint enforced programmatically for lot tracking
key_findings.analytic_removed: analytic_account_id fully absent in v19 Community mrp.production — no replacement in Community tier
key_findings.date_fields_renamed: date_planned_start → date_start; date_planned_finished → date_finished; both are now indexed and date_finished is computed
key_findings.availability_removed: Old availability field replaced by reservation_state + components_availability_state pair
key_findings.backorder_mechanism: _split_productions handles backorder creation; operation type create_backorder setting (always/ask/never) governs whether backorders are created automatically or via wizard
key_findings.workorder_auto_create: Work orders auto-created from BOM operations in draft state by _compute_workorder_ids; linked to moves at plan time by _link_workorders_and_moves
key_findings.button_mark_done_flow: Two-phase: pre_button_mark_done (checks + optional backorder split) then _post_inventory (validates moves, assigns lots from lot_producing_ids, posts finished goods)
